package.name: fiware_bridge
package.description: ROS 2 -> FIWARE NGSI-LD bridge. Subscribes the emori_msgs/Context stream and historizes every cycle to Orion-LD via the canonical schema (emori_adapter.fiware_schema), keyed off the per-session identity carried in the message; QuantumLeap historizes into TimescaleDB for the trainer dashboard.
